comment: Values are IL literals from oracle corpus v1. Tools/head_geometry_vectors.py verifies each (method, offset) pair against 05-evidence/corpus/v1/head-builder.il.json.

constants.name: minimumProngHeightMM
constants.use: HeadShape clamps prongHeight to 0.01 before any transform

constants.name: diameterOffsetMultiplier
constants.use: offset is applied to both sides of the gem: gemXSize + num * 2

constants.name: unitZScale
constants.use: Transform.Scale z factor for the base outline

constants.name: radialRayLengthMM
constants.use: length of the ray that finds the prong point on the girdle outline

constants.name: railDedupeDistanceMM
constants.use: consecutive rail points closer than this are removed

constants.name: railMidParameter
constants.use: midpoint parameter when only two rail points survive

constants.name: galleryRayLengthMM
constants.use: length of the horizontal ray that intersects the side rail

constants.name: galleryIntersectionToleranceMM
constants.use: curve/ray intersection tolerance for the gallery rail

constants.name: blendNearControl
constants.use: first interior Bezier control at 20 % of the chord

constants.name: blendFarControl
constants.use: second interior Bezier control at 40 % of the chord

constants.name: bezelSeatAngleOffsetDegrees
constants.use: seat lip is placed at seatAngle + 180 degrees

constants.name: bezelBlendThreshold
constants.use: percentage above which the seat uses a single BlendCurve join

claims.statement: The girdle, middle, base and top outlines come from the three HeadShape scale transforms and the null-base GetDrop branch.
ProngInterpCurve is a degree-3 chord-knot interpolation; this port uses a natural cubic spline.
claims.evidence: ProngInterpCurve IL_28/IL_124 and the captured call to CreateInterpolatedCurve(..., 3, Chord).
claims.documented_algorithm: RhinoCommon Curve.CreateInterpolatedCurve with degree 3 and chord-length knots; the natural-spline solver follows the standard C2 interpolation construction.

claims.statement: The prong section is an ellipse because the authored profile curve is not in the IL corpus.
claims.evidence: ProngProfileSweep scales an authored document curve; no numeric profile is captured.
claims.rationale: A 0.5 rounded-rectangle corner fraction is substituted; replacing it changes the section, not the recovered rail placement.

claims.statement: Gallery height, side-rail intersection scaling and the two offsets come from GalleryRail_V1.
claims.evidence: GalleryRail_V1 IL_74, IL_178, IL_212 and the two GemOffset calls.

claims.statement: The gallery band is rectangular and its elliptical offset adds to both radii.
claims.evidence: The vendor sweeps an authored RailProfile between two GemOffset curves; the exact parallel offset and profile are not numeric constants.
claims.rationale: Use the recovered offset distance and a constant-thickness band while the authored profile and exact offset solver remain uncaptured.

claims.statement: Each dome meridian is the captured six-point BlendCurve Bezier from the top section to the apex.
claims.evidence: CSUtilCurves.BlendCurve IL_72 and IL_119; ProngDomeCurve blend calls.
claims.documented_algorithm: CSUtilCurves.BlendCurve builds [start, start+d0*L*0.2, start+d0*L*0.4, end+d1*L*0.4, end+d1*L*0.2, end] and evaluates it as a Bezier.

claims.statement: The radial section direction is used as the start tangent of every meridian.
claims.evidence: ProngDomeCurve derives its tangents from the split profile after a Rhino intersection that is not reproduced.
claims.rationale: A radial meridian keeps the cap attached to the recovered top section; it changes the cap's curvature, not the section or the apex rule.

claims.statement: The seat folds from the girdle by seatHeight and then by seatLength at 180 degrees plus seatAngle.
claims.evidence: BezelProfile IL_2436 and the three-point seat polyline; the 180 degree offset is a literal.

claims.statement: The bezel is the captured seat profile swept around the recovered girdle, closed by an outer wall of width seatLength.
claims.evidence: RevolveBezel rules a surface between the bezel outline and the gem offset curve.
claims.documented_algorithm: A ruled surface between two closed curves, as RhinoCommon NurbsSurface.Create does in RevolveBezel.

claims.statement: The outward normal of the girdle ellipse is approximated by the radial direction.
claims.evidence: The exact GemOffsetCurve result is captured but not evaluated here.
claims.rationale: For the default round gem the two coincide; for fancy shapes the seat width varies slightly with the true normal.

claims.statement: Halo seat count, even-count adjustment, phase, wrap and sort come from PlaceGems.
The metal halo is a rectangular band swept along the recovered seat path.
claims.evidence: MakeHaloProfile builds an authored profile that is not reproduced; the seat path is recovered.
claims.documented_algorithm: A constant cross-section swept along a closed curve, the standard RhinoCommon Sweep1 construction.

claims.statement: Melee stones are rendered as octagonal proxy crowns at the recovered seats.
claims.evidence: CSGemInstance and the gem table are captured, but gem faceting is not ported.
claims.rationale: The proxies make seat spacing visible without claiming the gem geometry.
